Script.name: MedBootstrap
Script.script:
local meduiPackage = "MedUI"
-- function to install or update your MUD package local function installServerPackage() local installedVersion = mpkg.getInstalledVersion(meduiPackage) local repoVersion = mpkg.getRepositoryVersion(meduiPackage)
if not installedVersion then mpkg.install(meduiPackage) return end
-- repoVersion is nil when the listing has no MedUI if repoVersion and semver(installedVersion) < semver(repoVersion) then mpkg.upgrade(meduiPackage) end end
-- An uninstall leaves this script's timers running, and a reinstall runs it again MedBootstrap = MedBootstrap or {} MedBootstrap.run = (MedBootstrap.run or 0) + 1 local run = MedBootstrap.run
-- mpkg.install() gives up without retrying while the package listing is still -- downloading. Not mpkg.ready(): that starts another download each time it is false local function installWhenMpkgReady(triesLeft) if mpkg and mpkg.packages and mpkg.packages.packages then installServerPackage() elseif triesLeft > 0 then -- the preinstall list can put the bundled mpkg after this package if triesLeft == 11 and getPackageInfo("mpkg", "version") == "" then installPackage("https://github.com/Mudlet/mudlet-package-repository/raw/refs/heads/main/packages/mpkg.mpackage") end -- mpkg retries a failed listing download only every 12 hours if mpkg and (triesLeft == 8 or triesLeft == 4) then mpkg.updatePackageList(true) end tempTimer(5, function() if run == MedBootstrap.run and table.contains(getPackages(), "MedBootstrap") then installWhenMpkgReady(triesLeft - 1) end end) elseif table.contains(getPackages(), meduiPackage) then return elseif not mpkg then cecho("\n<orange>MedBootstrap: mpkg could not be installed, so MedUI is not installed yet. It will be tried again the next time this profile is opened.<reset>\n") else cecho("\n<orange>MedBootstrap: the package listing did not arrive, so MedUI is not installed yet. It will be tried again the next time this profile is opened.<reset>\n") end end
installWhenMpkgReady(12)
